articles.summary: DAIVIN! is pleased to announce its participation in Y-Combinator W26 batch! Read more here: https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/PE1-daivin-we-let-humans-breathe-underwater-without-oxygen-tanks
articles.title: DAIVIN! is part of Y-Combinator

articles.summary: DAIVIN! has successfully tested world first tankless dive technology. Powered by electrolysis this step opens up a big future potential for breathing technologies in the market. We are on a mission to make oxygen evermore accessible to people in a more safer and reliable way!See the video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r5HfL8Bw0dw
articles.title: DAIVIN! Tests tankless dive technology successfully!

articles.summary: We’re pleased to welcome Rear Admiral Matthew Burns , U.S. Navy (Ret.) as Senior Advisor to DAIVIN!
